text: ……って　どうじょうの　しはんに　おこられたっす　ウスッ！

structure.jp: どうじょうの　しはんに

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と that points back at words someone said. Here it picks up the line before. ……って　おこられた = 'I got scolded with those words'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: しはんに　おこられた
patterns.explanation: The れる ending shows the action was done to the speaker, and に shows who did it. しはんに　おこられた = 'I was scolded by the master'.
